intro: From April to July 2026, ZCyberNews published six articles under check-point-research, covering two critical and four high-severity vulnerabilities. The most frequently observed threat actor was Handala Hack, alongside Silver Dragon and The Gentlemen. Key CVEs included CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Affected sectors spanned government, consumer, critical infrastructure, mobile, and software consultancy, with incidents reported across Europe, Global, Israel, Middle east, and Southeast asia.
